note: Rule Registry. Buy/sell logic now switchable via a sidebar dropdown between Sequence Rule (default, the clean three-bar traversal), Original Triad (the v5.37.9 hypothesis with all gates and cooldown preserved unmodified), and Reversion Tier (the v5.37.10 exhaustion-plus-confluence-plus-pullback hypothesis preserved unmodified, known to misfire in sustained trends). Each rule is a named hypothesis with a name, description, color, and evaluate function returning buy and sell arrays. renderChart and backtestSignals both call RULE_REGISTRY[getActiveRule()].evaluate so chart triangles and win-rate stats stay in lockstep by design. Active rule persists in fl_tg_activeRule. Flow eternal applies to ideas as much as code — nothing gets lost.
